roadmap.title: Campaign run and collectibles
roadmap.description: Play missions 1-11 on Recruit or Soldier while collecting dog tags, audio logs and legendary weapons and clearing mission-specific goals.

roadmap.title: Stasis Interrupted
roadmap.description: Play the four-episode DLC included with the Collection; it gives no XP.

roadmap.title: Loadouts and shared-screen actions
roadmap.description: Spend commendations, edit loadouts and use a guest profile for co-op, revive and appearance items.

roadmap.title: Ultimate Badass and long grinds
roadmap.description: Replay on Ultimate Badass, then grind kills, ranks and challenges.

achievements.description: Complete Distress
achievements.summary: Complete the mission @loc{Distress}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Distress}, the first mission. The achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Complete Sulaco Falls
achievements.summary: Complete the mission @loc{Sulaco Falls}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Sulaco Falls}, the third mission. The achievement unlocks in the cutscene after you board the dropship.

achievements.description: Complete The Raven
achievements.summary: Complete the mission @loc{The Raven}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Raven}, mission 5. The achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.displayName: Still Got a Job to Do
achievements.description: Complete Rampart
achievements.summary: Complete the mission @loc{Rampart}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Rampart}, mission 8. The achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Complete Home
achievements.summary: Complete the mission @loc{Home}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Home}, mission 11. The achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Complete all Campaign levels on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete every campaign mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish all 11 campaign missions. Recruit or Soldier is a good choice for this first run.

achievements.description: Complete all Campaign levels on Hardened difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Needs a campaign run on Hardened or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete every campaign mission on Hardened difficulty.

guide.context: Finishing the campaign on Ultimate Badass also unlocks this, so you can skip a separate Hardened run.

steps.text: Finish all 11 campaign missions with the difficulty set to Hardened.

achievements.description: Complete all Campaign levels on Ultimate Badass difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Ultimate Badass run; plan as the second playthrough.
achievements.summary: Complete every campaign mission on Ultimate Badass difficulty.

guide.context: Plan this as your second run. It also gives you XP toward rank 60.

steps.text: Finish all 11 campaign missions with the difficulty set to Ultimate Badass.
In co-op, send one or two players at the @enemy{Raven} while the others clear @enemy{Xenomorphs}.
Against the @enemy{Crusher}, keep your distance, circle it and shoot its back.

achievements.description: Defeat all Xenomorphs in the Sulaco hanger bay without them crossing your barricade
achievements.summary: Kill every Xenomorph in the Sulaco hangar bay without any of them crossing your barricade.

guide.context: Xenomorphs go for real players before AI marines, so stay in front. Recruit difficulty helps. If one gets through, reload the checkpoint.

steps.text: In @loc{Distress}, at the hangar bay, stand in front of the barricade while your ally opens the door.
Kill every @enemy{Xenomorph} before it gets past the barricade. The shotgun works well.
When the big door opens, run through it. The achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Arm the emergency release and escape in under 2:30 on Sulaco Falls
achievements.summary: Arm the emergency release and reach the dropship in under 2:30 in Sulaco Falls.

guide.context: Use Recruit difficulty and a shotgun so you can run past enemies. Co-op also helps. The achievement unlocks in the cutscene after the mission. If you miss the time, replay from the checkpoint or mission.

steps.text: In the last hangar of @loc{Sulaco Falls}, the 2:30 timer starts as you enter. Run to all three emergency release switches and arm each one.
Drop down and board the dropship before the time runs out.

achievements.description: Find Newt's doll
achievements.summary: Find Newt's doll in The Raven.

steps.text: In the @loc{The Raven} sewers, find the room where sound-sensitive @enemy{Xenomorphs} walk around. Pull the third switch so they run to the generator and explode.
Keep going along the part of the sewer you have not seen, then look in a dead-end nook on the right.
Find the three barrels beside a yellow lamp. The doll head rests on one barrel. No button press is needed; stepping near it unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete Hope in Hadley's
achievements.summary: Complete the mission @loc{Hope in Hadley's}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Hope in Hadley's}, mission 9. The achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Complete One Bullet without setting off the alarm
achievements.summary: Complete One Bullet without anyone setting off the alarm.

guide.context: If an alarm goes off, replay the mission or reload the checkpoint from before it.

steps.text: In @loc{One Bullet}, two rooms hold scientists who can press an alarm button. Kill them quickly, before they reach it.
Finish the mission without triggering any alarm. The achievement unlocks at the end of the mission.

achievements.description: Defeat the Raven in under 1:10 on Soldier difficulty or higher
achievements.summary: Kill the Raven in 1:10 or less on Soldier difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Raven} on Soldier difficulty or higher.
At the end of the mission, fight the @enemy{Raven} in the @item{Power Loader}. Push it into a corner and punch quickly (LT on Xbox, L1 on PlayStation).
Kill it within 1:10. The mission ends when it dies, so if nothing unlocks, reload the checkpoint and try again.

achievements.description: Find the Easter Egg
achievements.summary: Enter the hidden room with 4 Alien Eggs in Battle for Sulaco.

steps.text: Early in @loc{Battle for Sulaco}, find the door with a keypad and enter the code.
Turn around and go back the way you came. A new door has opened.
Enter the room with 4 @item{Alien Eggs}. The achievement unlocks as you step in.

achievements.description: Gib two enemies at once
achievements.summary: Gib two enemies with one attack.

steps.text: Fire a grenade from an underslung launcher, for example on the pulse rifle, between two @enemy{Xenomorphs} standing close together.

achievements.description: Earn Rank 2 as a Marine
achievements.summary: Reach rank 2 as a Marine.

steps.text: Kill enemies in the campaign until you reach rank 2. You get a commendation for it.

achievements.description: Earn Rank 20 as a Marine
achievements.summary: Reach rank 20 as a Marine.

steps.text: Keep earning XP from kills, challenges and collectibles. The achievement unlocks at rank 20.

achievements.description: Earn Rank 60 as a Marine
achievements.sortReason: Long XP grind after all other XP sources.
achievements.summary: Reach rank 60 as a Marine.

guide.context: After two campaign runs and all challenges you are only near rank 49 or 50.

steps.text: Keep earning XP from kills, challenges, collectibles and multiplayer. The smart gun tunnels in @loc{No Hope in Hadley's} are a good place to farm.

achievements.description: Collect a Dog Tag
achievements.summary: Collect a Dog Tag.

steps.text: Pick up any dog tag. The first one in @loc{Distress} is on a crate on the catwalk to the right when the first pack attacks, during the flight recorder objective.

achievements.description: Collect all 35 Dog Tags
achievements.summary: Collect all 35 Dog Tags.

guide.context: Tags save when you pick them up, so you can leave a mission straight after. A tag cannot be picked up twice. Hold the select button in a mission to see how many you found there.

collectibles.name: Cpl. Dwayne Hicks
collectibles.method: When the first pack attacks, head right to the catwalk. The tag is on a crate.

collectibles.name: Pfc. M. Moore
collectibles.method: Look on the shelf by a small red book near a gravity well doorway. The tag is to its right.

collectibles.name: Pfc. S. Trubetskoy
collectibles.method: Search the crates along the rear wall of the control room, before you open the cargo bay doors.

collectibles.name: Cpl. Cynthia Dietrich
collectibles.location: Chamber opened with the Power Loader
collectibles.method: Enter the room and look left. The tag is on a cryo chamber.

collectibles.name: Sgt. Z. Forcher
collectibles.method: Follow the blood trails to an armor pickup. The tag is on a green crate to its right.

collectibles.name: Pfc. J. Ziglar
collectibles.method: After beating the soldiers, search a console on a raised tier.

collectibles.name: Pfc. Ricco Frost
collectibles.method: The tag is on top of a crate.

collectibles.name: Pfc. E. Greenlief
collectibles.method: Do not jump to the bottom. Drop down one or two platforms and look next to the armor and ammo.

collectibles.name: Cpl. T. Ashley
collectibles.method: Look right of the large crate.

collectibles.name: Lt. B. Norton
collectibles.method: In the room you cut open, on a white desk on the raised tier.

collectibles.name: Pfc. Trevor Wiersbowski
collectibles.method: After placing the first sensor, go into the small room on the right. The tag is on the gurney.

collectibles.name: Pfc. Jenette Vasquez
collectibles.method: With the smart gun, take the open room on the left. The tag is on a crate at the back.

collectibles.name: Pfc. M. Macaulay
collectibles.method: Follow the left hallway to a small drop. Walk a few steps forward, then turn around.

collectibles.name: Lt. William Gorman
collectibles.method: Lying on the big container to your left. Climb the nearby antenna to get up there.

collectibles.name: Cpt. C. Bradley
collectibles.method: At the foot of the large garage door.

collectibles.name: Pfc. M. Jelley
collectibles.method: Hidden behind a box beneath the first set of stairs.

collectibles.name: Cpl. M. Bailey
collectibles.method: Look for the dropship swerving around falling wreckage. The tag lies on a metal plate beside a cracked helmet.

collectibles.name: Pfc. J. Washenfelder
collectibles.method: On top of a yellow crate.

collectibles.name: Pfc. Daniel Spunkmeyer
collectibles.method: On the console O'Neal hacks to open the manifest.

collectibles.name: Sgt. Al Apone
collectibles.method: After Winter says they sealed the cavern up, turn right. The tag is on a crate on a short staircase.

collectibles.name: Pfc. K. Barrington
collectibles.method: Far end of the walkway that holds the alarm. Switch the alarm off before you grab it.

collectibles.name: Cpl. C. Nelson
collectibles.method: Go down the stairs and knock the cardboard boxes aside to find the tag.

collectibles.name: Pfc. Time Crowe
collectibles.method: In the third of the similar single-room buildings, on a crate.

collectibles.name: Cpl. S. Baroski
collectibles.method: Lying on a catwalk close to the alien weapon platform.

collectibles.name: Pfc. D. Capes
collectibles.method: Between the big green truck and the broken elevator, on a crate.

collectibles.name: Pfc. Mark Drake
collectibles.method: Rescue the marine Duplis in a lab first. The tag is on a long desk in the bigger lab outside, next to a microscope.

collectibles.name: Lt. P. Watkins
collectibles.method: After the vehicle bay stand, go down the ground-floor stairs into the tunnel. Use your flashlight to find it on the ground.

collectibles.name: Pfc. D. Rechner
collectibles.method: Enter the next building and look on a shelf.

collectibles.name: Sgt. R. Siwiak
collectibles.method: Go past the dropship to a crate next to a backhoe.

collectibles.name: Pfc. J. Ma
collectibles.method: On a crate at the near end of the catwalk.

collectibles.name: Pfc. P. Morales
collectibles.method: Near a forklift by the marines holding the area.

collectibles.name: Cpt. Colette Ferro
collectibles.method: Near the injured marines.

collectibles.name: Pfc. A. Montgomery
collectibles.method: Face the wall opposite the airlock door, turn left, walk about five steps, then turn right.

collectibles.name: Cpl. L. Papp
collectibles.method: On the small cart next to the large net-wrapped shipping container.

collectibles.name: Pfc. William Hudson
collectibles.method: On the far side of the crashed dropship, on the floor among the debris.

achievements.description: Collect a Legendary Weapon
achievements.summary: Collect a Legendary Weapon.

steps.text: Pick up any legendary weapon. @item{Hicks' Shotgun} is in @loc{Distress}: search the side rooms at the top of the gravity well for a yellow icon.

achievements.displayName: I Like to Keep These Handy
achievements.description: Collect all 6 Legendary Weapons
achievements.summary: Collect all 6 Legendary Weapons.

guide.context: Weapons save when you pick them up. They cannot be upgraded.

collectibles.name: Hicks' Shotgun
collectibles.method: Check the side rooms at the top. A yellow icon beside an armor pickup is the shotgun.

collectibles.name: Gorman's Pistol
collectibles.method: Take it from the table before you open the door where O'Neal waits.

collectibles.name: Hudson's Pulse Rifle
collectibles.method: Found in a corner office soon after you reunite with O'Neal.

collectibles.name: Vasquez's Smartgun
collectibles.method: Before going outside, turn around and look at the stack of pallets in the corner.

collectibles.name: Vasquez's Pistol
collectibles.method: Go down the left-hand hallway to the little room at its end. The pistol is tucked behind some crates.

collectibles.name: Frost's Flamethrower
collectibles.method: In the shipping container on your right with the RPG.

achievements.description: Complete a Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete one challenge.

steps.text: Reach rank 2, open the pause menu, choose Arsenal Upgrades and spend a point on a weapon upgrade. That finishes the first Marine challenge.

achievements.description: Complete an entire Challenge category
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge in one category.

guide.context: Each category has one active challenge at a time, in a fixed order. You can do them in the campaign or private multiplayer.

steps.text: Pick the Campaign category, which has the fewest challenges (13), and complete them in order.
They include finishing a mission on Hardened or higher and finishing a mission on Ultimate Badass.

achievements.description: Complete all Challenges
achievements.summary: Complete all 86 challenges.

guide.context: Some weapon challenges ignore legendary weapons, so use the standard version.

steps.text: Work on the active Marine, Campaign and Multiplayer challenge together and finish each as it unlocks.
For crowded fights, replay the corridor before the lift in @loc{Distress} and reload the checkpoint to repeat.

achievements.description: Have another player join your party
achievements.summary: Have another player join your party.

steps.text: At the main menu, sign a guest or second profile in on a second controller.

achievements.description: Revive a teammate
achievements.summary: Revive a downed teammate.

steps.text: Walk up to a downed player and revive them. Offline, use a second profile: down that player, then revive them.

achievements.displayName: Ready to Fry Half a City
achievements.description: Edit a Marine Loadout
achievements.summary: Edit a Marine loadout.

steps.text: Reach rank 3 to unlock your first new weapon, then change a marine weapon in Edit Loadouts.

achievements.description: Edit a Xenomorph Loadout
achievements.summary: Edit a Xenomorph loadout.

steps.text: In the main menu, go to Versus, then Edit Loadouts, then Xeno Loadout, and change an entry.

achievements.description: Upgrade every Loadout slot for a Xenomorph class
achievements.summary: Upgrade every loadout slot for one Xenomorph class.

steps.text: In the main menu, go to Versus, then Edit Loadouts, then Xeno Loadout.
Spend points on every loadout slot of one class: Soldier, Spitter or Lurker.

achievements.description: Upgrade every slot for a weapon
achievements.sortReason: All slots including skins for a weapon.
achievements.summary: Upgrade every slot of one weapon, including its weapon skins.

steps.text: In Versus, Customization, Edit Loadouts, Marine Loadouts, open one weapon and buy every upgrade and every weapon skin.

achievements.displayName: You Look Just Like I Feel
achievements.description: Upgrade every Appearance slot once for your Marine
achievements.summary: Buy one upgrade in every Appearance slot for your marine.

steps.text: In Versus, Edit Loadouts, open your marine Appearance options and buy one upgrade in every slot.

achievements.description: Upgrade every Appearance slot once for a Xenomorph class
achievements.summary: Buy one upgrade in every Appearance slot for a single Xenomorph class.

steps.text: In Versus, Edit Loadouts, Xeno Loadout, pick one class and buy one upgrade in each Appearance slot: head, skin and shoulders.
For shoulders, choose the option that removes one or both pads.

achievements.description: Purchase all Upgrades for a weapon
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for one weapon.

steps.text: Reach rank 18 so all combat pistol upgrades are available.
In Versus, Customization, Edit Loadouts, Marine Loadouts, open the combat pistol and buy each upgrade. Skins are not needed.

achievements.description: Spend 30 Commendations
achievements.summary: Spend 30 Commendations.

steps.text: You earn one commendation per rank. Spend each on weapon upgrades in the Arsenal Upgrades menu until you have spent 30. This is around rank 31.

achievements.description: Collect all 12 Audio Logs
achievements.summary: Collect all 12 Audio Logs.

guide.context: Audio logs show as glowing laptops. They save when you pick them up.

collectibles.name: Mission 1 audio log
collectibles.method: After the circular room with the rotating machine, it is on a table in the room where a Lurker attacks.

collectibles.name: Mission 2 audio log A
collectibles.method: Once the Power Loader has opened the warehouse door, look for it sitting on a crate by a locked door.

collectibles.name: Mission 2 audio log B
collectibles.method: In the last engineering room, on the tall counter on the right, or the green generator right of the entrance if you jump.

collectibles.name: Mission 4 audio log
collectibles.method: Just inside the colony, resting on a desk in an early open room.

collectibles.name: Mission 6 audio log A
collectibles.method: When Bella says she hates heights, drop down and turn around. It is at the end of the scaffold.

collectibles.name: Mission 6 audio log B
collectibles.method: In the armory, in a small room to the left of the entry, soon after the last log.

collectibles.name: Mission 6 audio log C
collectibles.method: Disable the turret at the end of the corridor, then cut open the door at the other end.

collectibles.name: Mission 7 audio log A
collectibles.method: Where the scientist stands behind the window in the room after the cutscene.

collectibles.name: Mission 7 audio log B
collectibles.method: Next to a dead body.

collectibles.name: Mission 7 audio log C
collectibles.method: After the APC section, in the little office full of screens.

collectibles.name: Mission 8 audio log A
collectibles.method: In the first side room on the right, at the end, on a table.

collectibles.name: Mission 8 audio log B
collectibles.method: In the first of three small buildings, on a desk.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Xenomorphs that are using vents
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Xenomorphs while they are moving through vents.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Xenomorphs} while they come out of or move through vents. @loc{Distress} has many early on.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Xenomorphs in a game with the M56A2 Smart Gun
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Xenomorphs with the M56A2 Smart Gun.

steps.text: In @loc{No Hope in Hadley's}, pick up the @item{Smart Gun} and go into the tunnels. Kill 10 @enemy{Xenomorphs} with it.

achievements.description: Set up a UA 571-C Remote Sentry
achievements.summary: Deploy a UA 571-C Remote Sentry.

guide.context: You can also place one as a marine in multiplayer Survivor.

steps.text: In @loc{No Hope in Hadley's}, pick up the sentry turret when the mission asks and set it up in Operations. The achievement unlocks once it is active.

achievements.description: Track 100 hostile targets with the Motion Tracker
achievements.summary: Detect 100 hostile targets using the Motion Tracker.

steps.text: Keep the @item{Motion Tracker} out while enemies are close. Your tracked targets add up over the game.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with a single U4 Firebomb
achievements.summary: Take out 3 enemies with one U4 Firebomb.

steps.text: Equip @item{U4 Firebombs} as your tactical item and throw one into a tight group of enemies. The corridor before the lift in @loc{Distress} is crowded.

achievements.description: Kill a Xenomorph with a shotgun at very close range
achievements.summary: Shoot a Xenomorph dead with a shotgun from point-blank range.

steps.text: Let a @enemy{Xenomorph} get close and shoot it with a shotgun at point-blank range.

achievements.description: Kill a Xenomorph climbing on the walls or ceiling
achievements.summary: Kill a Xenomorph climbing on a wall or ceiling.

steps.text: In @loc{Distress}, the second Xenomorph you meet drops from a vent and scales a wall. Shoot it quickly.

achievements.description: Kill 5 Spitters without being damaged by acid
achievements.summary: Kill 5 Spitters without taking any acid damage.

steps.text: In @loc{For Bella}, in the cave with @enemy{Spitters} on the walls, shoot them from far away and keep moving.
Kill 5 without taking acid damage.

achievements.description: Melee a Lurker that is pouncing towards you
achievements.summary: Melee a Lurker that is pouncing at you.

steps.text: When a @enemy{Lurker} jumps at you, hit it with a melee attack. Use a strong weapon if one hit is not enough.

achievements.description: Kill 2179 Xenomorphs
achievements.summary: Kill 2179 Xenomorphs.

guide.context: The kill count adds up across all play, so normal runs also count.

steps.text: Finish the campaign and challenges first. Then in @loc{No Hope in Hadley's}, take the @item{Smart Gun}, kill 20 to 30 @enemy{Xenomorphs} in the tunnels, and reload the checkpoint from just before the gun.
Repeat until the achievement unlocks, and stop before you reach the three @enemy{Lurkers}.

achievements.description: Kill a Crusher without it damaging you
achievements.summary: Kill the Crusher without it damaging you.

guide.context: If the Crusher hits you, reload the checkpoint. It puts you right before the fight.

steps.text: At the end of @loc{Hope in Hadley's}, fight the @enemy{Crusher}. Keep your distance and shoot its back while it charges.
Kill the other @enemy{Xenomorphs} that join in.

achievements.description: Survive a Close Encounter with a Facehugger
achievements.summary: Survive a Facehugger close encounter.

guide.context: Facehuggers first appear in mission 2.

steps.text: When a @enemy{Facehugger} grabs you, tap the interact button until you break free.

achievements.description: Rescue a teammate from a Close Encounter
achievements.summary: Save a teammate who is caught in a close encounter.

guide.context: It also works with an adult Xenomorph grabbing a teammate.

steps.text: Play co-op @loc{Battle for Sulaco}. When a @enemy{Facehugger} grabs your partner, run up and kill it while they struggle.

achievements.displayName: Thank You, That Will Be All
achievements.description: Complete Stasis Interrupted on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Stasis Interrupted on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish all four episodes.
In the last area, survive the firefight while Hicks sends the message. It lasts about 3 to 4 minutes.
Climb the six flights of stairs. In the V-shaped array room, trigger the two switches, then watch the ending.

achievements.description: Complete Stasis Interrupted on Ultimate Badass
achievements.summary: Complete Stasis Interrupted on Ultimate Badass.

steps.text: Play all four episodes on Ultimate Badass. There is no HUD and friendly fire hurts.
In the firefight before the final battle, stay out of the sentries' line of fire.

achievements.description: Find All Stasis Interrupted Audio Logs
achievements.summary: Find all 10 Stasis Interrupted audio logs.

guide.context: Once you purge the gas in the Queen module you cannot go back, so a missed log means replaying that episode.

collectibles.name: Asylum audio log A
collectibles.method: In the room before the vent directly in front of you.

collectibles.name: Asylum audio log B
collectibles.method: Turn right at the end of the corridor. It is in the last lab on the left; going up the stairs misses it.

collectibles.name: Awakening audio log A
collectibles.method: Right beside your path.

collectibles.name: Awakening audio log B
collectibles.method: Immediately on your left on a bench.

collectibles.name: Deliverance audio log A
collectibles.method: At the back of the first building.

collectibles.name: Deliverance audio log B
collectibles.method: Take the top path after the bridge.

collectibles.name: Redemption audio log A
collectibles.method: On the floor to the left.

collectibles.name: Redemption audio log B
collectibles.method: Keep right of the two floor lights, close to the ammo dump before the Queen.

collectibles.name: Redemption audio log C
collectibles.method: Upstairs by the last eggs.

collectibles.name: Redemption audio log D
collectibles.method: Up the stairs, kill the Xenomorph, and follow the path to the desk.

achievements.displayName: I Only Need To Know One Thing
achievements.description: Find your family
achievements.summary: Find your family in Stasis Interrupted.

steps.text: In the first episode, Asylum, follow the single path through the cargo bay. The cutscene with your parents unlocks it.

achievements.description: Destroy the Legato
achievements.summary: Destroy the Legato.

steps.text: At the end of Asylum, in engineering, kill the 4 mercenaries at the top. One has a smart gun.
Pull the two levers on the wall and the one on the floor. The mission ends and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Sever the umbilical without missing a shot
achievements.summary: Sever the umbilical in Stasis Interrupted without missing a shot.

guide.context: On Ultimate Badass, take your time with each shot; the achievement can fail there.

steps.text: In Awakening, sit in the gun control seat and charge the gun as soon as it deploys. Let the sight settle after it is fully charged.
Hit all four crosses on the umbilical, starting at the far right, then centre left, centre right, and finally far left. Do not miss any.

achievements.displayName: They're Dead, OK? Can We Go Now?
achievements.description: Kill all the Lurkers in Sulaco engineering
achievements.summary: Kill all the Lurkers in the Sulaco engineering section of Stasis Interrupted.

guide.context: There are about 3 Lurkers on Recruit and Hardened; Ultimate Badass and co-op may have more.

steps.text: In Awakening, go through the steaming door on the left of the corridor with a view of space.
Lurkers hiss and attack from the shadows. They mostly attack on your way back from the fuel valve computer, not on the way there.
Kill the first behind a column on the far left, then the one that retreats and charges after the control room, then the last behind barrels through the large hole to the right.
If the achievement does not unlock, go back to the fuel valves and sweep again.

achievements.displayName: Now What Are We Supposed To Do?
achievements.description: Escape the FTL ship
achievements.summary: Escape the FTL ship in Stasis Interrupted.

steps.text: In Deliverance, kill the mercenaries, then use the console to reach the EEV and watch the cutscene.
After you land on the surface, follow the path. The achievement unlocks as you look down it.

achievements.description: Survive the Queen escape
achievements.summary: Survive the Queen escape in Stasis Interrupted.

steps.text: In Redemption, in the Queen chamber, run around the pillars and hug the walls so she cannot reach you.
Find the slightly lighter path out of the chamber. The Queen leaves and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: It's The Only Way To Be Sure
achievements.description: Destroy all samples in the labs of the Queen module
achievements.summary: Destroy every sample in the Queen module laboratories.

guide.context: After you purge the gas you cannot go back. If you missed a sample, replay the episode.

steps.text: At the first lab, shoot both glass cases in front. Use the switch to burn the 2 eggs in the cabinet.
In the room on the left, shoot the 3 Facehuggers in jars. At the back, shoot the 3 eggs above the beds. Upstairs, shoot 2 more eggs. That is 12.
Go on through the airlock. Press the button to burn the eggs, then shoot the 8 eggs in the cubicles on the right.
Finish at the U-shaped corridor: shoot the 4 glass cases around the bed.
